description: Implement a multi-provider CSV import framework with provider detection, provider-managed mappings, deterministic normalization-before-dedupe, and optional per-row AI message cleanup in review.

userStories.title: Add provider mapping schema and Prisma models
userStories.description: As a developer, I want provider mappings stored in the database so parse and review flows can use configurable provider definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Prisma models for import provider mapping definitions including provider name, source-to-canonical field mappings, and normalization rule payloads
Persist mapping version metadata (timestamp or version field) for diagnostics
Run Prisma generate successfully after schema change
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement provider detection service and parse diagnostics
userStories.description: As a user, I want the importer to auto-detect provider from CSV headers so imports start with the right mapping.
acceptanceCriteria: Add provider detection logic based on configurable header/pattern rules
Parse response includes detection diagnostics with detected provider id/name and detection confidence state
When no provider match is found, parse response marks detection as uncertain or missing
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add manual provider override to import parse flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manually select provider before parsing when detection is wrong or uncertain.
acceptanceCriteria: Import parse endpoint accepts explicit provider override and uses it instead of auto-detection
Import UI requires provider selection when detection is uncertain or missing
User can change provider selection before parsing continues
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Transform provider CSV rows into canonical import rows
userStories.description: As a user, I want provider-specific CSV data mapped to canonical importer fields so review and submit behavior stays consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse pipeline loads selected provider mapping and transforms rows into existing canonical import row shape
Row-level validation errors are returned in structured diagnostics
Parse summary shape remains exactly: imported, duplicates, ignoredReserved, invalid
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Normalize payment type and merchant fields before dedupe
userStories.description: As a user, I want duplicate detection to remain deterministic across providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider normalization runs before fingerprint generation
Payment-type labels normalize to Prisma PaymentType values before dedupe
Fingerprint continues using accountId, bookingDate, amountNok, normalizedMerchant, and paymentType
Duplicate warnings in review payload are based on normalized canonical values
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add provider mapping admin APIs with validation
userStories.description: As an admin, I want CRUD APIs for provider mappings so new providers can be configured without code edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Add API endpoints for create, update, list, and delete of provider mappings
Validation blocks save when required canonical fields are missing
API persists provider normalization rules and mapping version metadata
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Build provider mapping admin UI
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a UI to manage provider mappings so I can maintain import support operationally.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin UI can create and edit provider mappings with source-column to canonical-field assignments
Admin UI surfaces validation errors for missing required canonical fields
Admin UI supports editing provider normalization rules
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add optional OpenAI message cleanup enrichment service
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want AI message cleanup to run as best-effort enrichment so imports never fail when AI is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: AI cleanup is executed only when OPENAI_API_KEY is configured
When key is missing or provider call fails/timeouts, parse/review/submit flows continue without failure
Review/session payload includes reason codes for unavailable suggestions (disabled, key missing, timeout, provider error)
Diagnostics avoid logging sensitive raw message content
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Show AI message suggestions in review with per-row selection
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose original or AI-cleaned message per row before submit.
acceptanceCriteria: Review table shows original message and optional AI-cleaned suggestion for each row
Each row has explicit control to choose original vs AI-cleaned message
Default selection behavior is deterministic and documented in UI copy
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Persist per-row message source decisions on submit
userStories.description: As a user, I want submitted transactions to persist the exact message choice I made during review.
acceptanceCriteria: Submit endpoint accepts finalized per-row message selection values
Persisted transactions use chosen message text per row
Submitted review session cleanup remains atomic with transaction persistence
